title: Capability observation
description: One thing actually seen about one capability. Optional structured context supports practical routing and feedback without turning observations into a mastery model.

capability_ref.description: The one capability this observation is about.

method.description: Human-readable description of how it was observed.

evidence_kind.description: Small machine-readable distinction used for evidence precedence. DIRECT_ATTEMPT is current task evidence; the PRIOR values are imported historical evidence.

question_ref.description: Optional worksheet/canonical question identifier that produced this observation. It is descriptive unless separately resolved by an academic contract.

observed.description: What the learner actually did or produced.

independence.description: Human-readable note about whether the learner had help.

help.description: Structured amount of help available during the observed attempt.

error_stage.description: Earliest meaningful failure stage when one can be identified.

provenance.description: Evidence-layer provenance. LIVE_LEARNER is reserved for a reviewed observation of an actual learner session. Session-runtime drafts remain UNREVIEWED_SESSION_DRAFT until a person reviews and explicitly persists them. Historical imports and synthetic tests can inform their own workflows but never satisfy live empirical acceptance.
